summary: A retail-heavy morning with major developments in distribution agreements and funding, plus Reliance's significant bond issuance. Vadilal Enterprises' blocking of a 10-year distribution renewal with Vadilal Industries signals potential disruption in ice cream retail, while Reliance prepares its first rupee bond sale since 2023.

bullets.text: Vadilal Enterprises blocks renewal of 10-year distribution pact with ice cream maker Vadilal Industries, disrupting domestic supply chain.
Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion via rupee bond sale next week, first such offering since 2023.
India's next e-commerce surge targets 300 million tier-two and tier-three city consumers, projected to reach $80-90 billion market size.
Consumer startups raised over Rs 300 crore this week; Sorry Sugar, Marmalade, and Lickicious combined raised Rs 30+ crore.
Chief Justice Sunita Agarwal outlined five principles balancing AI use with human judgment in arbitration at India Digital ADR Summit 2026.
